additionalRules: Beast Warrior models may only be included in Druzhag's Warband.

specialRules.name: "We cannot get out, they are coming."
specialRules.text: Friendly Moria Goblin models Engaged in Combat with an enemy model that would be considered Trapped gain a bonus of +1 to their Fight Value for the duration of the Combat.

specialRules.name: Skittering Warriors
specialRules.text: Friendly Moria Goblin models gain the Mountain Dweller special rule.

specialRules.name: Durburz's Will
specialRules.text: Once per game, at the start of his Activation, Durburz may declare he is using this ability. If he does, Durburz may not Move during his Activation; however, all friendly Moria Goblin models gain a bonus of +2" to their Move Value until the End Phase of the turn. Additionally, in a turn in which Durburz uses this ability, all friendly Moria Goblin models within 6" of him automatically pass any Courage Tests required when attempting to Charge a model with the Terror special rule.

specialRules.name: Breathe Fire
specialRules.text: The Dragon can Breathe Fire as a shooting attack during the Shoot Phase; treat this as a bow with a range of 12". If the shot hits, then the model that is hit suffers a Strength 10 hit and if they suffer a Wound from this hit, which is not prevented, they are automatically slain. Additionally, all other models (friend and foe) within 2" are immediately Set Ablaze - though they will not be automatically slain if wounded. This is a fire-based attack.

specialRules.name: Fly
specialRules.text: The Dragon gains the Fly special rule and increases its Move Value to 12" whilst using the Fly special rule.

specialRules.name: Superior Intellect
specialRules.text: The Dragon automatically passes any Intelligence Tests it is required to take. Additionally, each time the Dragon spends a Might Point, roll a D6. On a 4+, the Might Point is free and does not reduce the Dragon's store of Might.

specialRules.name: Tough Hide
specialRules.text: The Dragon increases its Wounds and Defence to 9 each.

specialRules.name: Wyrm Magic
specialRules.text: The Dragon gains a free Will Point at the start of each turn. If this free Will Point is not spent by the end of the turn, it is lost. The Dragon may also cast the following Magical Powers shown on its profile.

specialRules.name: Iron Fist
specialRules.text: The range of Durburz's Stand Fast is 12" rather than 6".

specialRules.name: Callous Leadership
specialRules.text: Once per game, at the start of any Fight Phase, before the Declare Heroic Actions Step, Durburz can declare he is using this ability. Until the End Phase of the turn, friendly Goblin models within 6" of Durburz gain a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes. However, any other friendly Goblin model within 6" that loses a Duel Roll (not including Supporting models) must roll a D6 after any Strikes have been made against them. On the roll of a 1, the model suffers a Wound.

specialRules.name: Death-touch
specialRules.text: Any model that Wounds Ashrak in Combat, or is Wounded by Ashrak in Combat, must immediately roll a D6. On a 4+ the model immediately suffers the effects of the Paralyse Magical Power; however, the effects will not immediately end should Ashrak have no Will Points or be slain.

specialRules.name: Spider-kin
specialRules.text: Only Spider models may benefit from Ashrak's Stand Fast or Heroic Actions. Additionally, whilst within 3" of a friendly Spider model, Ashrak gains the Terror special rule.

specialRules.name: Master of the Dark Wild
specialRules.text: Friendly Beast models within 12" of Druzhag may use his Courage or Intelligence values instead of their own when making a Courage Test or an Intelligence Test. Additionally, whenever Druzhag suffers a Wound, before any Fate Rolls are made, he may roll a D6. On a 2+, he may choose a single friendly Beast model within 2" to immediately suffer the Wound instead of him. Fate Rolls can then be made as normal.

specialRules.name: Mithril Crown
specialRules.text: This is a Unique piece of wargear. Friendly Moria Goblin models within 3" of Groblog gain the Dominant (2) special rule.

units.name: Cave Drake
units.keywords: DRAKE, MORIA, HERO, INFANTRY, MONSTER, BEAST

specialRules.name: Protect the Nest
specialRules.text: At the beginning of the game, after both sides have deployed, you may place a single 25mm Nest Marker anywhere on the board. Whilst within 3" of a friendly Nest Marker, a Cave Drake has the Fearless special rule.

specialRules.name: Cornered Beast
specialRules.text: If a Cave Drake loses a Duel Roll and is Trapped, then after any Strikes have been made against it the Cave Drake will lash out. When a Cave Drake lashes out, any models (friend or foe) that were Engaged in Combat with it, or are within 1" of it, will immediately suffer a Strength 4 hit.

specialRules.name: Gaping Maw
specialRules.text: Instead of making Strikes, a Cave Drake may choose a single enemy model on a 25mm base that was involved in the same combat and roll a D6. On a 2+, the chosen model suffers a Wound and, if this Wound is not prevented, the model is swallowed whole and removed as a Casualty. If the Cave Drake slays a model with this Brutal Power Attack, they may immediately regain a Wound lost earlier in the battle.

units.name: The Watcher in the Water
units.keywords: KRAKEN, MORIA, HERO, INFANTRY, MONSTER, UNIQUE

specialRules.name: Independent Hero
specialRules.text: Independent Heroes may not lead troops and may not be the army's leader. They may, however, be included in another Hero model's warband as one of their followers.

specialRules.name: Many Tentacles
specialRules.text: Whilst the Watcher in the Water has 3 or fewer Wounds remaining, its Attacks are reduced to 3.

specialRules.name: Water Dweller
specialRules.text: The Watcher in the Water is never slowed when Moving within a water feature, can still Shoot whilst within deep water, and always counts as rolling a 6 on the Swim Chart. Additionally, whilst within a water feature, the Watcher in the Water increases its Move Value to 8" and gains the Monstrous Charge special rule.

specialRules.name: From the Deep
specialRules.text: The Watcher in the Water can never be part of another Hero model's Warband. When you deploy your Army, do not deploy the Watcher in the Water - keep it aside for later. During the Priority Phase, after Priority has been determined, the Watcher's controlling player must decide if they wish for the Watcher to enter play. If they do, they must roll a D6 and on a 3+ the Watcher is ready to enter play. If this roll is failed, you must roll in each subsequent Priority Phase until the Watcher is ready to enter play. When the Watcher is ready to enter play, immediately place it anywhere on the battlefield; however, the Watcher cannot displace other models when it enters play in this manner. The Watcher in the Water cannot Charge on the turn in which it arrives, but may otherwise act normally.

specialRules.name: Grasping Tentacles
specialRules.text: In the Shoot Phase, the Watcher in the Water may make D6 shooting attacks. These have a range of 6", a Strength of 3 and never require In The Way Rolls. The Watcher can still make these shooting attacks regardless of how far it Moved in the Move Phase, and never suffers the -1 penalty for Moving and Shooting. Additionally, any model that is hit by a tentacle and is not slain will be removed from the board and then placed anywhere in base contact with the Watcher in the Water, as chosen by the Watcher in the Water's controlling player.

specialRules.name: Dragged to the Depths
specialRules.text: Instead of making Strikes, if the Watcher is within 6" of a water feature it may use this Brutal Power Attack. If it does, select a single enemy model that was involved in the Combat and roll a D6. On a 2+, the model suffers a Wound and, if the Wound is not prevented, the model will immediately be slain. The Watcher is then removed from the battlefield and its controlling player must roll to see if it enters the battlefield again in the same manner as described in the From the Deep special rule.

units.name: Bat Swarm
units.keywords: BAT | MORIA | WARRIOR, INFANTRY, BEAST, SWARM | 40MM

specialRules.name: Blinding Swarm
specialRules.text: Enemy models Engaged in Combat with a Bat Swarm halve their Fight value.

specialRules.name: Troll Chain
specialRules.text: This is a throwing weapon with a range of 3" and a Strength of 5.

specialRules.name: Troll Spear
specialRules.text: This is a spear. Additionally, if this model is not Supporting, any To Wound Rolls of a natural 6 it makes when making Strikes that are not prevented will deal 2 Wounds rather than 1.

specialRules.name: Murderous Power
specialRules.text: Each time a Dweller in the Dark slays a model in Combat, it regains a single Wound lost earlier in the battle. These Wounds are regained at the end of the Combat. A Dweller in the Dark can only regain Wounds in this way by making Strikes, never by using a Brutal Power Attack.

units.name: Mirkwood Hunting Spider
units.keywords: SPIDER | DOL GULDUR | WARRIOR, INFANTRY, BEAST | 40MM

specialRules.name: Silent Hunters
specialRules.text: If a Mirkwood Hunting Spider is within a piece of woodland terrain (such as a forest), or is partially concealed by a piece of woodland terrain, then they cannot be seen by enemy models unless they are within 6" of the Mirkwood Hunting Spider.

specialRules.name: Run and Drum
specialRules.text: The Drum is considered to be playing as long as both the Drummer and Drum Bearer are in base contact, and the Drummer is not Engaged in Combat. Whilst the Drum is being played: friendly Moria Goblin models gain a bonus of +1 to any Courage Tests they are required to take; enemy models suffer a -1 penalty to any Courage Tests they are required to take; friendly Moria Goblin models within 18" count as being in range of a banner; the Moria Blackshield Drum counts as a banner for the purpose of Victory Points.

specialRules.name: Take up the Drum
specialRules.text: If the Moria Blackshield Drummer or Moria Blackshield Drum Bearer is slain, then they may pass on their wargear to a friendly Moria Blackshield Warrior within 1" of them. The chosen model becomes a Moria Blackshield Drummer/Drum Bearer (as applicable) and exchanges their wargear for that of the slain model.

specialRules.name: Moria Goblin Drum
specialRules.text: A Moria Goblin Drum is always on a 25mm base and must be deployed in base contact with one of its Moria Goblin Drummers during deployment. It is a Heavy Object that can be shot at normally; it has a Defence of 10 and 3 Wounds. If, during the End Phase of a turn, an enemy model is in base contact with the Moria Goblin Drum and did nothing but Move that turn, it can remove the Drum from play.

specialRules.name: Drums in the Deep
specialRules.text: For the Drum to be played, at least one Moria Goblin Drummer must be in base contact with it, have not Moved that turn, and not be Engaged in Combat. Whilst played: friendly Moria Goblin models gain +1 to Courage Tests; enemy models suffer -1 to Courage Tests; friendly Moria Goblin models within 18" count as being in range of a banner; the Drum counts as a banner for Victory Points.

specialRules.name: Take up the Drum
specialRules.text: If a Moria Goblin Drummer is slain, they may pass on their wargear to a friendly Moria Goblin Warrior within 1" of them, who becomes the new Drummer.

units.name: Moria Goblin Drummer
units.keywords: GOBLIN | MORIA | WARRIOR, INFANTRY | 25MM (included with Moria Goblin Drum)

units.name: Warg Marauder
units.keywords: GOBLIN | MORIA | WARRIOR, CAVALRY | (three Moria Goblin Warriors on one Warg)
wargear: Either Shield or Orc Bow (two riders have Orc bows, one has a shield)

specialRules.name: On the Hunt
specialRules.text: During the Shoot Phase, a Warg Marauder can make a shooting attack with an Orc bow for each Moria Goblin Warrior with an Orc bow still alive upon the Warg. These shooting attacks can still be made even if the Warg Marauder has Moved further than half its Move Value that turn, and even if it is Engaged in Combat.

specialRules.name: Lethal Union
specialRules.text: Whilst the Goblins remain mounted upon the Warg, the entire model gains the Terror special rule and gains a bonus of +1 to any Courage Tests it is required to take. Additionally, during a Combat a Warg Marauder gains an additional Attack for each Goblin after the first that is still mounted upon the Warg, provided they did not shoot during the Shoot Phase.

specialRules.name: Composition note
specialRules.text: A Warg Marauder consists of three Moria Goblin Warriors riding a single Warg Mount. Two of the Warriors have an Orc bow, the other has a shield. Whilst the Warrior with shield remains alive, all parts of the Cavalry model gain the +1 Defence bonus. The Warg Marauder only counts as a single model towards an Army's Bow Limit.

sourceNotes: Roster, points, and army-wide rules from the prancingponypub Moria army-list page. Full stat blocks from The Misty Mountains faction page for Dragon, Durburz, Druzhag, Cave Drake, Watcher in the Water, Bat Swarm, Cave Troll, Goblin/Blackshield units; from Evil Legacy for Ashrak, Groblog, Dweller in the Dark and Warg Marauder; and from Gundabad & Dol Guldur for Fell Warg and Mirkwood Hunting Spider.
